wholeGoal.title: Reduzierende Kohlenhydrate nachweisen und erklären
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann kontrollierte Fehling- beziehungsweise in der Lehrplanroute verlangte Benedict-Nachweise durchführen, auswerten und positive sowie negative Kohlenhydratbefunde durch zugängliche Carbonylformen und die Verknüpfung anomerer Zentren erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can carry out and evaluate controlled Fehling assays, or Benedict assays required by the curriculum route, and explain positive and negative carbohydrate results through accessible carbonyl forms and anomeric-centre linkages.

records.validScientificCore: Controlled source-appropriate Fehling/Benedict performance, actual recording, positive/negative controls, Cu(II)/Cu(I) interpretation, carbonyl access/anomeric-linkage explanations and a changed-carbohydrate transfer remain valuable and necessary. The chemistry is not rejected because the profile scope is too broad.
records.actualOverreach: The actual mandatory aspect-2 asks fructose isomerisation through enediols. Both source-required-assay variation texts demand glucose/sucrose to maltose/fructose transfer in both routes. The complete Fehling case-2 and Benedict case/rubric repeat that requirement without an HE-basic versus appropriate-advanced condition.
records.whyNotUniversal: The original HE Q2.1 page places Fehling with aldoses and disaccharide reduction on shared basic level, but fructose keto-enol tautomerism under elevated LK. A chemically interesting fructose transfer is not automatically an essential HE-GK completion gate. Selecting Benedict rather than Fehling is a method-route distinction and does not by itself establish a track requirement for fructose tautomerism.

wholeCaseFindings.finding: Keep the complete controlled glucose/sucrose/water Fehling acquisition route, actual record requirement and structural explanation. The already supplied task can support the common core.

Keep genuine changed-substance transfer and maltose reasoning; condition the added fructose/enediol demand on a literal appropriate route or make it an explicitly separate optional extension for HE-basic. The full task and full-credit/rubric references must agree, not just the profile brief.

Keep the concrete method, controls, actual records, deviation checks and independent transfer. Its current material names fructose, its task requires that comparison, and rubric criterion4 requires fructose rearrangement. A basic-route alternative must be coherent across all these fields; preserve the complete advanced case as enrichment or an exact route-specific branch.

smallestAuthorRemedy.preserve: Common execution/controls/evaluation and a chemically changed maltose transfer with valid evidence. Retain useful whole advanced fructose cases; do not delete science or replace performance by an expected answer.
smallestAuthorRemedy.changeOnly: Add an explicit basic-versus-required-advanced choice to actual whole case-2 and the complete Benedict route, and align mandatory aspect-2/variation/rubric/brief wording with that choice. The HE-basic branch must be completable with correct glucose/sucrose/maltose reasoning and actual controlled performance. The fructose/enediol branch remains compulsory only where a read literal source route requires it, e.g. the HE elevated contribution.
smallestAuthorRemedy.noUnrequestedMutation: No goal description, image, graph, Normal record, source map or fingerprint is changed by this audit.

records.claimScope: No complete universal basic-route P approval until the exact full-material successor is reviewed. Retained scientific core is E1 design content; no real execution or learner mastery is certified.

wholeGoal.title: Aminosäuren über Säure-Base-Verhalten erklären
wholeGoal.titleEn: Explain amino acids through acid-base behaviour
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann pH-abhängige Ladungszustände einfacher Aminosäuren und ihr amphoteres Verhalten im Donator-Akzeptor-Konzept anhand von Strukturformeln erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain pH-dependent charge states and amphoteric behaviour of simple amino acids using donor-acceptor concepts and structural formulas.

resourceLinks.altText: Drei vereinfachte dominante Glycinformen bei pH2, pH6 und pH12 tragen die Gesamtladungen +1,0 und −1. Das Zwitterion in der Mitte zeigt gleichzeitig NH3+ und COO−.

records.validScientificCore: Glycine dominant+1/0/−1 structural forms and donor/acceptor explanation are appropriate. The second lysine case usefully tests an additional ionisable side chain: COO− plus two NH3+ gives dominant net+1, compared with predominantly net0 glycine. This is genuine fresh charge-balance transfer.
records.actualOverreach: The whole current goal requires pH-dependent charge states and amphoteric behaviour using structures. It does not require an electric-field/electrode model. Nevertheless, mandatory aspect-2 observable performance and whole case-2 demand explaining negative-electrode/cathode migration. That application adds a physical analytical context beyond the stated acid/base competence.
records.scientificNuance: The positive-charge migration reasoning is a legitimate optional simple electrophoresis application, not false acid/base chemistry. Cathode sign is contextual to that driven setup; no universal electrochemical sign rule is inferred. The issue is making this extra performance indispensable to this literal goal.

wholeCaseFindings.finding: Keep all supplied pKa values, dominant structural forms, formal charge sums and ampholyte explanation. No need to drop the pH comparison.

Keep lysine pKa values, pH7 form, all three ionisable groups, comparison with glycine and the justified charge sum as the compulsory independent transfer. Separate the migration question and answer as a clearly voluntary extension; correct charge reasoning must suffice for this aspect without solving an unrequested electrode application.

smallestAuthorRemedy.preserve: The full charged-side-chain transfer, structural formulas and all-group balance. No removal of required acid/base evidence and no new test quota.
smallestAuthorRemedy.changeOnly: In the actual whole case-2 and its rubric/full-credit evidence, separate electric migration into an optional extension. Align mandatory aspect-2 and its case brief to charge/form/amphoteric reasoning. The original migration science can remain in the extension; it must not block mastery of the literal e9 target.
smallestAuthorRemedy.noUnrequestedMutation: No whole goal, image, graph, Normal record, source map or fingerprint is changed here.

wholeCaseCorrectionFields: rubric.criteria where migration would otherwise be compulsory
records.claimScope: Keep the valid E1 charge-model design science, but no complete unchanged-profile P acceptance with this additional mandatory performance.

unchangedEvidenceCompletionRule.rule: A rich coherent piece of independently produced work with genuine changed-case transfer can supply sufficient evidence. Count demonstrated understanding/performance and independence, not task labels, separate chats or a fixed number of extra experiments. Once all applicable aspects including real performance where required are adequately shown, no additional attempt is demanded merely to meet a quota.
unchangedEvidenceCompletionRule.whatRemainsRequired: For1d2e, actual controlled performance, genuine observations and source-appropriate independent transfer are still required. A synthetic answer or a plan does not establish execution. For e9, the structural protonation/charge explanation and genuine new ionisable-group transfer remain required.
unchangedEvidenceCompletionRule.currentProfileInterpretation: The existing minimumIndependentDemonstrations=2 and fresh-transfer language must not be interpreted as a fixed additional laboratory-run requirement after complete evidence. Distinct independent aspects can occur within one coherent extended work product. The literal two-run author case is an available evidence route, not a reason to repeat already demonstrated work.
unchangedEvidenceCompletionRule.authority: This is the user-preserved evidence rule; no runtime/schema/profile normalization is performed by this audit.

reviewBoundary: Exactly two current whole goals/profiles and five matching original whole cases/rubrics. No D-peer findings were read, no D judgment is issued, and other jurisdictions/mappings are not broadly reviewed.
